# awesome claude notes

> Independent community distribution of AI coding workflow assets derived from affaan-m/ECC, focused on Chinese documentation, packaging, and cross-harness use.

Core documentation:
- README.md
- ROADMAP.md
- GOVERNANCE.md
- UPSTREAM.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- TROUBLESHOOTING.md
- docs/SELECTIVE-INSTALL-ARCHITECTURE.md

Core assets:
- agents/
- commands/
- skills/
- hooks/
- rules/
- mcp-configs/
- manifests/

CLI entry points:
- npx ecc <language>
- npx ecc-install <language>
- node scripts/install-plan.js --profile <name> --target <harness>
- node scripts/install-apply.js --profile <name> --target <harness>

Provenance and support:
- Upstream source: https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC
- Distribution repository: https://github.com/loulanyue/awesome-claude-notes
- Security reports: use the repository Security tab, not a public Issue
